ns2:course.label: Grain Drying and Conditioning
ns2:course.description: (AG E 387) Psychrometric principles of air modification for dehydration and conditioning of moist products, emphasizing the drying of cereal grains; industrial dryers; design of drying, cooling, and aeration systems. Includes laboratory. Prerequisite: ABE 222 or consent of instructor; ME 300 recommended.
